name: cdk-a11y
description: Combines cdkTrapFocus with LiveAnnouncer to keep keyboard focus inside a custom modal panel while it's open and announce its opening to screen reader users.
templateCode: Confirm action
notes: cdkTrapFocusAutoCapture moves focus into the panel the moment it's attached — without it, cdkTrapFocus only constrains Tab cycling to elements already inside the panel, but never moves focus there in the first place.
LiveAnnouncer.announce() injects its text into an off-screen aria-live region rather than the panel itself, so it's heard even when the panel's own heading is only focused, not read aloud, on open.
cdkTrapFocus does not restore focus to the triggering element when the panel closes — save the previously focused element (document.activeElement) before opening and refocus it explicitly in close().
